eyebrow: Glue job, then a Lambda notification
code:
RunGlueJob:
  Type: Task
  Resource: arn:aws:states:::glue:startJobRun.sync
  Parameters:
    JobName: orders-etl-job
  Next: NotifyComplete

NotifyComplete:
  Type: Task
  Resource: arn:aws:lambda:...:notify-slack
  End: true
caption: The .sync suffix waits for the Glue job to finish, not just start.
